Message.Name: EQ Time Message
Message.Description: A Time message is immediately generated and sent when there is a PITCH event for a given clock second

Field.Name: Time
Field.Description: Number of whole seconds from midnight Eastern Time

Message.Name: EQ Unit Clear Message
Message.Description: The Unit Clear message instructs feed recipients to clear all orders for the Cboe book in the unit specified in the Sequenced Unit Header

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Message.Name: EQ Order Executed Message
Message.Description: Order Executed messages are sent when a visible order on the Cboe book is executed in whole or in part

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that was executed

Field.Name: Executed Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts executed

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this execution. Execution Id is also referenced in the Trade Break message

Message.Name: EQ Order Executed at Price Size Message
Message.Description: Order Executed at Price/Size messages are sent when a visible order on the Cboe book is executed in whole or in part at a different price than the limit price on the original Add Order message or the limit order price in the latest Modify Order message referencing the Order Id

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that was executed

Field.Name: Executed Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts executed

Field.Name: Remaining Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts remaining after the execution

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this execution. Execution Id is also referenced in the Trade Break message

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The execution price of the order
